# Strategy to implement: ordered attempt [contiguous-interval-dynamic-programming] Sort-by-density segment DP over cut po

Mechanism family: contiguous-interval-dynamic-programming
Replacement scope: Add as a third construction path alongside greedy and target_greedy in the seeding loop; keep all existing seeds and the SA polish.
Gain mechanism: The incumbent's per-model sequential assignment cannot enforce global structure; a DP over contiguous segments of a density-sorted order explores a geometrically different solution topology (block assignments) that greedy step-by-step decisions systematically miss, at exact-polynomial cost.
Compute budget: One sort + O(n²·gpu_num) DP per ordering key (at most 3 keys), well under 0.1 s for typical n; no iterative optimizer.
Plan: (1) Sort models by req_rate/slo/model_size (pressure density) descending; also try by req_rate/slo and by model_size. (2) DP over positions: f[i][k] = minimal achievable max-KVPR when the first i models (in sorted order) are split into k contiguous groups, each group assigned to one distinct GPU.
